fppa_right.name: fppa_right
fppa_right.display_name: Right Knee Frontal Plane Projection Angle
fppa_right.formula: 180 - angle(hip->knee, knee->ankle), signed via cross-product offset from hip-ankle line.
fppa_right.coordinate_convention: Frontal plane (XY). Positive values indicate medial displacement (valgus), negative indicate lateral displacement (varus).
fppa_right.description: 2D frontal-plane projection angle proxy for dynamic right knee valgus collapse.

knee_flexion_left.name: knee_flexion_left
knee_flexion_left.coordinate_convention: 0 deg = fully extended anatomical reference, positive degrees indicate increasing flexion.

knee_flexion_right.name: knee_flexion_right
knee_flexion_right.coordinate_convention: 0 deg = fully extended anatomical reference, positive degrees indicate increasing flexion.

hip_flexion_left.name: hip_flexion_left
hip_flexion_left.coordinate_convention: Angle from trunk axis in degrees; 0 deg = neutral standing.
hip_flexion_left.description: Left hip sagittal angle between thigh segment and trunk midline.

hip_flexion_right.name: hip_flexion_right
hip_flexion_right.coordinate_convention: Angle from trunk axis in degrees; 0 deg = neutral standing.
hip_flexion_right.description: Right hip sagittal angle between thigh segment and trunk midline.

hip_abduction_left.name: hip_abduction_left
hip_abduction_left.coordinate_convention: Frontal plane deviation in degrees relative to vertical.
hip_abduction_left.description: Frontal plane angle of left thigh vector relative to gravity vertical.

hip_abduction_right.name: hip_abduction_right
hip_abduction_right.coordinate_convention: Frontal plane deviation in degrees relative to vertical.
hip_abduction_right.description: Frontal plane angle of right thigh vector relative to gravity vertical.

ankle_dorsiflexion_left.name: ankle_dorsiflexion_left
ankle_dorsiflexion_left.coordinate_convention: 0 deg = neutral 90 deg included angle; positive = dorsiflexion, negative = plantarflexion.
ankle_dorsiflexion_left.description: Sagittal plane left ankle dorsiflexion/plantarflexion angle.

ankle_dorsiflexion_right.name: ankle_dorsiflexion_right
ankle_dorsiflexion_right.coordinate_convention: 0 deg = neutral 90 deg included angle; positive = dorsiflexion, negative = plantarflexion.
ankle_dorsiflexion_right.description: Sagittal plane right ankle dorsiflexion/plantarflexion angle.

trunk_lean.name: trunk_lean
trunk_lean.coordinate_convention: 0 deg = vertical spine; positive = lateral angular deviation from vertical.
trunk_lean.description: Lateral inclination of trunk segment in the frontal plane from vertical.

trunk_flexion_deg.name: trunk_flexion_deg
trunk_flexion_deg.formula: angle(trunk midline, vertical axis in sagittal projection).
trunk_flexion_deg.coordinate_convention: 0 deg = upright torso; positive = forward sagittal trunk flexion.
trunk_flexion_deg.description: Sagittal inclination of trunk segment relative to vertical axis.

pelvic_obliquity_deg.name: pelvic_obliquity_deg
pelvic_obliquity_deg.formula: atan2(right_hip_y - left_hip_y, right_hip_x - left_hip_x) in degrees.
pelvic_obliquity_deg.coordinate_convention: 0 deg = level horizontal pelvis; positive = left hip higher / contralateral drop.
pelvic_obliquity_deg.description: Angle of inter-hip line relative to horizontal reference.

knee_valgus_LSI.name: knee_valgus_LSI
knee_valgus_LSI.coordinate_convention: Percentage [0, 200%]; 0% = perfect bilateral symmetry; >15% indicates significant asymmetry.
knee_valgus_LSI.description: Normalized Limb Symmetry Index (LSI) comparing left and right knee valgus angles.

knee_flexion_LSI.name: knee_flexion_LSI
knee_flexion_LSI.description: Normalized Limb Symmetry Index (LSI) comparing left and right knee flexion.

knee_valgus_at_initial_contact.name: knee_valgus_at_initial_contact
knee_valgus_at_initial_contact.display_name: Knee Valgus Angle at Initial Contact
knee_valgus_at_initial_contact.formula: max(fppa_left, fppa_right) sampled at landing initial contact frame.
knee_valgus_at_initial_contact.coordinate_convention: Frontal plane angle in degrees at contact instant.
knee_valgus_at_initial_contact.description: Peak frontal plane projection knee valgus at ground impact instant.

knee_flexion_at_initial_contact.name: knee_flexion_at_initial_contact
knee_flexion_at_initial_contact.display_name: Knee Flexion Angle at Initial Contact
knee_flexion_at_initial_contact.formula: mean(knee_flexion_left, knee_flexion_right) sampled at initial contact frame.
knee_flexion_at_initial_contact.coordinate_convention: Degrees; <25 deg indicates stiff, high-impact landing strategy.
knee_flexion_at_initial_contact.description: Bilateral mean knee flexion angle at ground impact instant.

valgus_duration.name: valgus_duration
valgus_duration.description: Total duration during landing contact window where knee valgus exceeds pathological 10 deg threshold.

com_displacement.name: com_displacement
com_displacement.coordinate_convention: Cumulative normalized units across trial duration.
com_displacement.description: Cumulative spatial trajectory displacement of Dempster segmental Center of Mass.

knee_ap_translation_mm.name: knee_ap_translation_mm
knee_ap_translation_mm.formula: Physical depth or stereo calibrated sagittal translation. Strictly gated: returns 'not available' on monocular RGB video without depth.
knee_ap_translation_mm.description: 6-DOF anterior-posterior tibial translation relative to femur.
knee_ap_translation_mm.notes: Requires depth sensor or multi-camera stereo calibration. Monocular RGB video does not provide metric depth.

knee_ml_translation_mm.name: knee_ml_translation_mm
knee_ml_translation_mm.formula: Physical depth or stereo calibrated frontal translation. Strictly gated: returns 'not available' on monocular RGB video without depth.
knee_ml_translation_mm.description: 6-DOF medial-lateral tibial translation relative to femur.
knee_ml_translation_mm.notes: Requires depth sensor or multi-camera stereo calibration. Monocular RGB video does not provide metric depth.

knee_si_translation_mm.name: knee_si_translation_mm
knee_si_translation_mm.formula: Physical depth or stereo calibrated axial translation. Strictly gated: returns 'not available' on monocular RGB video without depth.
knee_si_translation_mm.notes: Requires depth sensor or multi-camera stereo calibration. Monocular RGB video does not provide metric depth.

knee_int_ext_rot_deg.name: knee_int_ext_rot_deg
knee_int_ext_rot_deg.formula: Physical depth or stereo calibrated transverse rotation. Strictly gated: returns 'not available' on monocular RGB video without depth.
knee_int_ext_rot_deg.description: 6-DOF transverse axial rotation between tibia and femur.
knee_int_ext_rot_deg.notes: Requires depth sensor or multi-camera stereo calibration. Monocular RGB video does not provide metric depth.
